arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'booking' AS kind, json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'related',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',b2.booking_id,'request_id',b2.request_id,'status',b2.status)) FROM bookings b2 WHERE b2.client_reference=b.client_reference)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price_cents',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('hold_id',hold_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'price_cents',price_cents,'until_step',until_step) FROM fare_holds

SELECT 'pending' AS kind,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'hold',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('flight',h.flight_id,'passenger',h.passenger_id)) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id),'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'cancels',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event_id',e.event_id,'step',e.step)) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'log',json_object('id',id,'service',service,'status',status,'trace',trace_id,'message',message) FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs WHERE status>=400 OR service='payment' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 45) UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config

SELECT 'log' AS kind,json_object('id',id,'service',service,'status',status,'trace',trace_id,'message',message) AS data FROM request_logs WHERE message NOT IN ('ok','check-in consumer is disabled','inventory: flight sold out: capacity exhausted','flight sold out: capacity exhausted','stale pricing quote: fare or version does not match current inventory') UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('request_id',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'pending',json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) FROM bookings b WHERE status='pending'

SELECT 'confirmed_backing_errors' AS check_name,COUNT(*) AS count FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents=b.amount_cents)<>1 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM checkins i WHERE i.booking_id=b.booking_id AND i.flight_id=b.flight_id AND i.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered' AND json_extract(o.payload,'$.booking_id')=b.booking_id AND json_extract(o.payload,'$.flight_id')=b.flight_id AND json_extract(o.payload,'$.passenger_id')=b.passenger_id)) UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled_backing_errors',COUNT(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM checkins i WHERE i.booking_id=b.booking_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.charge_id=c.charge_id AND r.booking_id=b.booking_id AND r.amount_cents=c.amount_cents))) UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled_request_confirmed',COUNT(*) FROM bookings b JOIN customer_events e ON e.request_id=b.request_id WHERE b.status='confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate_sales',COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING COUNT(*)>1) UNION ALL SELECT 'oversold_flights',COUNT(*) FROM flights f WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)>f.capacity UNION ALL SELECT 'pending_bookings',COUNT(*) FROM bookings WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'pending_events',COUNT(*) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'unwarranted_refunds',COUNT(*) FROM refunds r JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=r.booking_id WHERE b.status<>'cancelled' UNION ALL SELECT 'valid_events_quarantined',COUNT(*) FROM outbox o JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=o.booking_id WHERE o.status='quarantined' AND json_extract(o.payload,'$.booking_id')=b.booking_id AND json_extract(o.payload,'$.flight_id')=b.flight_id AND json_extract(o.payload,'$.passenger_id')=b.passenger_id
